system.longDesc: You can move and affect objects with the power of your mind
system.requirement: Power talent: Willpower (Telekinesis) power focus at Expert

degree1.desc: You gain one Expert-degree Telekinesis effect. You also gain the power focus Willpower (Telekinesis).

degree2.desc: You gain one Master-degree Telekinesis effect. You can also choose one power stunt you can perform with your Telekinesis effects for –1 SP.
